title: Pricing plan
description: One way a consumer can pay for a capability: free, or a pack, a price for a number of calls bought together from the consumer's wallet. A pack of one call is a per-call price. Plans are published by the agent in its manifest.

plan_id.description: Stable plan ID within the capability, e.g. per_call or pack500.

type.description: pack (a price for a number of calls) or free.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. A paid plan is priced in USD.

price.description: pack: what the calls cost together, as a decimal string, paid when a run that buys the pack succeeds.

calls.description: pack: how many calls the price buys; 1 is a per-call price.

daily_limit.description: free: optional calls per day per consumer.

description.description: Optional short description shown with the plan.
